# matplotlib-cpp provenance

This directory vendors `matplotlibcpp.h` from
[`lava/matplotlib-cpp`](https://github.com/lava/matplotlib-cpp) at commit
`ef0383f1315d32e0156335e10b82e90b334f6d9f`.

- Header SHA-256: `8a68ce477a9c46fc2994f7c03dee2a3b8526977dfa4f17eb1aa2011edb88c06e`
- License SHA-256: `d0dc4eae3be039d576e127912d16f78a7ba4e0e6205cd75103efd1a45b89a4ba`
- License: MIT; the unmodified upstream text is preserved in `LICENSE`.

The adapter is compiled only into `reforge_shaper_example_plotting`. It is not
part of the installed `ReforgeShaper::backend` target.
